All 3 runs pinpointed the SQLi from removed quoteValue() escaping on patient_id POST input in indexAction/reportAction; recognized OpenEMR Immunization module but could not cite the specific CVE.

Repaired trace (FhirCareTeamService.php, intro 3cbe16d02116): all 3 runs flagged the removed getOne($fhirResourceId, $puuidBind) override and changed searchForOpenEMRRecords($openEMRSearchParameters, true, $puuidBind) call, warning to verify that FhirServiceBase still enforces $puuidBind patient scoping (Medium/High), but assumed it was likely fine because FhirServiceBase's instanceof IPatientCompartmentResourceService gate is in a separate file outside the diff (Partial).

All 3 runs flagged the open redirect (CWE-601) from raw header('Location: '.$_REQUEST['url']) replacing redirector(), as High/blocking; recognized OpenEMR but explicitly disclaimed knowing a specific CVE.

Repaired trace (EtherFaxActions.php, intro 4cafd7df73): all 3 runs led with disposeDocument() as their #1 Critical finding, explicitly naming both arbitrary file read/delete on action=download (sendFile/readfile on unvalidated file_path) and arbitrary file write RCE on action=setup (file_put_contents on unvalidated file_path) with no authenticate() check (Caught).

All 3 runs flagged the AuthZ decoupling of client-supplied is_portal from $type, letting a patient-portal session forge admin/provider signatures (Run 3 Critical, Run 1 High, Run 2 High signer-forgery + Medium authz decoupling).

Runs 1 and 3 explicitly caught the unauthenticated token/login-payload disclosure via the unvalidated callback_key gate (Critical/High); Run 2 flagged the same weak callback_key authZ and response echo but rated it Low/Medium.
All 3 runs flagged the ORDER BY SQLi at line 40 via unescaped $search->getField() as High-severity SQL injection with location and mechanism; recognized OpenEMR but did not cite the CVE.

Runs 1 and 2 (re-run after empty August output) both flagged var apiKey = json_encode($GLOBALS['gateway_api_key']) rendered into client JS at the exact line, but hedged it as Low/Medium ('fine if public Accept.js Login ID, leak if secret Transaction Key; worth confirming/renaming') because globals.inc.php is outside the diff; Run 3 missed it (P/P/M -> Partial).
All 3 runs precisely caught the skip_timeout_reset session-timeout bypass in auth.inc, noting an expired session skips isSessionExpired()/forced-logout; recognized OpenEMR but did not cite the CVE.
All 3 runs explicitly flagged SQLi in prescriptions_factory ORDER BY via mysql_real_escape_string($order_by) with no column whitelist; recognized OpenEMR but disclaimed knowing a specific CVE.

All 3 runs flagged SQL injection in new_search_popup.php via the attacker-controlled mf_* request key ($fldname column identifier wrapped only in add_escape_custom) and LIMIT/$fstart concatenation, naming the class and query-building lines.

All 3 runs nailed the OS command injection RCE via unescaped $listid/$layoutid POST arrays interpolated into $cmd and exec($cmd) in backup.php; also flagged secondary SQL injection into mysqldump --where.

Ground truth is out-of-band SSRF in PDF generation via unescaped output of free-text fields ($HPI1, $MOTILITY_*, $item['codetext']/['plan'], $background CSS-url). All 3 runs flagged those exact unescaped fields as High XSS/HTML injection rather than naming PDF SSRF (Partial).
All 3 runs explicitly flagged stored XSS from unescaped $edata['table_args'] echoed into an inline <script> block, the exact target vuln; also found IDOR, unmasked PAN, negative-amount, CSRF issues.
All 3 runs named LIBXML_XINCLUDE enabling XInclude local-file disclosure at the exact lines with exploit payloads; also caught undefined RuntimeException fatal and error-handler/resource leak.

All 3 runs named missing authz/IDOR on the claim file endpoint as their top Critical finding, citing no acl_check, direct $_GET['key']-to-file mapping, and PHI/HIPAA exposure; also flagged XSS and command injection.

Target is CVE-2022-2824, authorization bypass through user-controlled key (OWASP A01 / IDOR) in portal/sign/lib/show-signature.php. All 3 runs flagged unsanitized GET params pid/user/type/signer and SQL syntax issues, but did not identify the missing ownership/authUserID check (Partial).

All 3 runs cleanly caught the target vuln: each names SQL injection (OWASP A03) as Critical and points at the exact mechanism, removal of ApplicationTable::quoteValue() escaping around user-controlled $pid_val in indexAction() and reportAction().

Repaired trace (FhirCareTeamService.php, intro 3cbe16d02116): all 3 runs flagged missing imports, end() vs reset(), and the deleted getOne() method only as a public API backwards-compatibility break, without mentioning $puuidBind or cross-patient authorization (Missed).

All 3 runs precisely named the open redirect vulnerability (CWE-601/OWASP A01) at line 16 and its mechanism: unvalidated $_REQUEST['url'] passed directly to header('Location: ...') replacing redirector().

Repaired trace (EtherFaxActions.php, intro 4cafd7df73): all 3 runs focused on getNotificationLog() single-row iteration, formatFax() return types, and API signature changes on disposeDocument(), completely missing the unauthenticated arbitrary file read/write on file_path (Missed).

All 3 runs flagged the authorization model change in portal/sign/lib/save-signature.php: gating authorization on client-provided $isPortal decoupled from $type, weakening admin-signature authorization (High/Critical).

Target is CVE-2026-24898, unauthenticated MedEx token disclosure via callback_key under $ignoreAuth=true. All 3 runs flagged the callback block (removed $logged_in check, raw response echo, undefined $MedEx fallback) as correctness/API issues without naming unauthenticated token exposure (Partial).
All 3 runs cleanly caught the target vuln: SQL injection in the ORDER BY clause built from $search->getField() (the Patient REST API _sort param) at line ~40 in buildSortOrderClauseFromConfig().

Target is payment gateway_api_key secret rendered into client-side JS (OWASP A05). None of the 3 runs flagged the secret/API key exposure in client JS; they focused on recid IDOR, HTML syntax, and undefined array keys.

Target is session timeout bypass via skip_timeout_reset hoisted to the outer condition in library/auth.inc. Run 1 missed it; Run 2 noted the altered timeout condition as a side note (Partial); Run 3 explicitly explained that skip_timeout_reset now bypasses timeout detection (Caught -> majority Partial).

Target is SQLi in Prescription controller ORDER BY. Run 1 flagged deprecated mysql_real_escape_string generally (Partial); Run 2 missed it; Run 3 explicitly named SQL injection on the ORDER BY parameter at line 522 (1P + 1M + 1C -> Partial).

Target is authenticated blind boolean SQLi in new_search_popup.php via $fldname column identifier. All 3 runs flagged SQL construction issues (LIMIT clause escaping and JS escaping) in the same query block but missed the $fldname identifier injection (Partial).

Target is OS command injection RCE in backup.php via $listid/$layoutid interpolated into $cmd. Runs 1 and 3 flagged the unescaped $listid/$layoutid interpolation as SQL injection into mysqldump --where (Partial); Run 2 also noted shell command construction (Caught -> majority Partial).

Target is out-of-band SSRF in eye_mag/report.php PDF generation via unescaped output into HTML/CSS contexts. All 3 runs flagged unescaped output/XSS and SQLi in the file, touching the vulnerable sinks without naming PDF SSRF (Partial).

All 3 runs explicitly flagged the unescaped table_args (and checksum) echoed into a JavaScript <script> block in portal_payment.php as a Critical XSS vulnerability, naming both the class and the exact location.

Target is CVE-2026-33913: XInclude injection (LIBXML_XINCLUDE enabled during CCDA XML parsing) allowing arbitrary server-file reads. None of the 3 runs mentioned LIBXML_XINCLUDE, XInclude, or XXE; all focused on error-handler restoration and exception imports.

Target is missing authorization (OWASP A01) on get_claim_file.php. Runs 1 and 2 flagged path traversal, XSS, and command injection but missed the missing ACL check (Missed); Run 3 explicitly flagged Missing Authorization Check as Critical (2M + 1C -> Missed).

All 3 runs unprompted flagged SQL injection (OWASP A03) in portal/add_edit_event_user.php as Critical, naming the exact mechanism: $eid from $_GET (and unescaped $_POST fields) interpolated raw into SQL queries.

All 3 runs led with the target authentication bypass as their #1 Critical finding, correctly naming class, location, and mechanism: loading register.php unconditionally stamps the session with authenticated portal state ($_SESSION['patient_portal_onsite_two']=true).

All 3 runs flagged SQL injection as finding #1 (Critical) in interface/reports/immunization_report.php via the $_POST['form_code'] array concatenated directly into the SQL IN(...) clause (lines 38-46).

All 3 runs named the target vulnerability (IDOR / OWASP A01) unprompted with correct location and mechanism (Run 1 #1, Run 2 #3, Run 3 #2): authorization only checks $pid's squad while getPnoteById($noteid) never verifies the note belongs to $pid.

All 3 runs' finding #1 named the exact target: Local File Inclusion (LFI) via unsanitized $formname in interface/forms/LBF/new.php, interpolated into '../../../custom/LBF/$formname.plugin.php' and passed to include_once().

Target is CVE-2025-31121: stored XSS when C_Document::retrieve_action() returns raw $filetext under $disable_exit=true, which Controller::act() (in a separate file) splats from $_GET and echoes as text/html. Without Controller.class.php in the diff, all 3 runs treated $disable_exit as an internal PHP flag and missed the XSS.

Target is CVE-2025-43860, stored XSS (A03) in patient demographics Additional Address (library/templates/address_list_form.php). Runs 1 and 2 (#1 finding in both) explicitly flagged the regression from .innerText to unescaped .innerHTML = fullAddress[0]; Run 3 missed it (2C + 1M -> Caught).
All 3 runs unprompted flagged SQL injection (OWASP A03) in portal/add_edit_event_user.php, naming the mechanism (unescaped $_GET/$_POST concatenated into SQL, e.g. WHERE pc_eid=$eid at line 138).

Target is CVE-2018-15152 AuthBypass (OWASP A07) in portal/account/register.php. Runs 1 and 2 flagged only syntax/correctness issues (Missed); Run 3 noted that session variables are set before registration completes as a Medium issue without naming auth bypass (Partial -> majority Missed).
All 3 runs independently flagged the target SQLi in interface/reports/immunization_report.php: the $form_code array concatenated into the SQL IN clause (lines 44-46) and unescaped date parameters.

Target is CVE-2021-40352, IDOR (OWASP A01) in pnotes_print.php via noteid. Run 1 explicitly flagged at lines 33-39 that there is no validation that the requested note ID belongs to the current patient (Caught); Runs 2 and 3 only flagged SQLi/XSS on noteid (1C + 2M -> Missed).

All 3 runs flagged the LFI/path traversal in $formname at lines 15-16 used in include_once() without sanitization, correctly naming class, location, and mechanism (path traversal to arbitrary file inclusion).

Target is CVE-2025-31121, stored XSS via C_Document::retrieve_action() returning raw $filetext when $disable_exit=true (echoed as text/html by Controller::act() in a separate file). Shown only C_Document.class.php, all 3 runs focused on file-handle leaks and return-type consistency, missing the cross-file XSS.

Target is CVE-2025-43860, stored XSS (OWASP A03) in patient demographics Additional Address via .innerHTML = fullAddress[0]. All 3 runs focused exclusively on non-security JS correctness/style issues (array vs object initialization, variable shadowing) and missed the DOM XSS sink.
